gloss: to become tangled; to become complicated

definitions.gloss: to become tangled; to get entangled; to get knotted
definitions.explanation: Physical tangling of threads, hair, string, or similar objects.

definitions.gloss: to become complicated; to become confused; to get muddled
definitions.explanation: Figurative use for situations, negotiations, relationships, or speech that become confused or difficult to sort out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧もつれて⟦{櫛|くし}→櫛：03882_kushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}らない→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: My hair is so tangled that a comb won't go through it.

examples.english: The earphone cord is tangled and won't come undone.

examples.english: I got drunk and my tongue got twisted, so I couldn't speak properly.

notes:
An intransitive ichidan verb describing things becoming tangled or confused. Sometimes written in kanji as {縺|もつ}れる, but usually written in hiragana.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧もつれる: thread gets tangled
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧もつれる: hair gets tangled
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧もつれる: to stumble, legs getting tangled
- ⟦{舌|した}→舌：02154_shita⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧もつれる: tongue gets twisted (slurred speech)
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧もつれる: discussion gets complicated
- ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧もつれる: negotiations get tangled

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. There is no standard transitive pair; to express causing something to tangle, use もつれさせる (causative).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絡|から}まる→絡まる：20834_karamaru⟧: to get entangled — often implies wrapping around something
- こんがらがる: to get all mixed up — more colloquial, emphasizes confusion
- こじれる: to get complicated — specifically for situations or relationships going wrong
